detail: 6679dae0e gate-4 developer image, small preset (--max-transactions 16384 --max-history-octets 8388608 --max-record-octets 196608 --max-groups-per-article 16 --max-open-suffix 128), SBCL_USER_ARGS '--dynamic-space-size 1068MB --tls-limit 16384', 1 connection, 1,000 POSTs x 2048 octets, 16G swarm-build cgroup, hbox load 4-5 (shared). Two of ten runs of the MEM-003 hook harness (hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/n-mem3/mem3.py, hook arm 0 and arm 1, which do not collect or allocate beyond logging) ended in `POST 575: 440 posting not permitted now; the articles in flight fill the memory, try again later` (dir dev-r1-a0, owner.err 607 accepted posts, last t17-000574) and `POST 807: 440 ...` (dir dev-r1-a1, last t17-000806). Not established from the logs: whether the refused funding leaves article slots held (the 440 follows the refusal in both runs), or whether the slot book refuses on its own budget. title: two of ten runs refused POSTs with 440 'articles in flight fill the memory' at 575 and 807 after live history root allocation refused (REFUSED MEMORY-BUDGET-EXHAUSTED)
